title: field to ugrid
explanation:
### Description

Read a field representing an unstructured grid via a write/read round-trip, then visualize a blow-molding simulation with mold wireframe, parison surface, and thickness contours.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkActor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkActor.html) — assigns the mapped geometry to the scene.
- [vtkConnectivityFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkConnectivityFilter.html) — connectivity filter.
- [vtkContourFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkContourFilter.html) — extracts iso-surfaces at specified scalar values.
- [vtkDataObjectReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObjectReader.html) — data object reader.
- [vtkDataObjectToDataSetFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObjectToDataSetFilter.html) — data object to data set filter.
- [vtkDataObjectWriter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObjectWriter.html) — data object writer.
- [vtkDataSetMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetMapper.html) — maps any dataset type to graphics primitives.
- [vtkDataSetToDataObjectFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataSetToDataObjectFilter.html) — data set to data object filter.
- [vtkFieldDataToAttributeDataFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkFieldDataToAttributeDataFilter.html) — field data to attribute data filter.
- [vtkGeometryFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGeometryFilter.html) — extracts the outer surface of a dataset.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkPolyDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataMapper.html) — maps polygonal data to graphics primitives.
- [vtkPolyDataNormals](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPolyDataNormals.html) — computes surface normals for smooth shading.
- [vtkUnstructuredGridReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkUnstructuredGridReader.html) — unstructured grid reader.
- [vtkWarpVector](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkWarpVector.html) — warp vector.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
